title: protocol(pm): a silent claim has no reclaim clock or write path — seat-lifecycle.md:37's one-day recycle names no actor, so p1 #21892 idles 34 h with no PR and its serial dependent #21915 waits
body:
Guards: dispatch liveness — a silent claim (`seat-lifecycle.md:37`) is reclaimed by a named actor on a named clock through the relay, so a serial dependent never waits on a dead seat.
Filing gate: ① a reproducible defect in the dispatch protocol: the lifecycle rule 「无心跳,活性惰性判定:超过一天无自有产出即可降级回收」 (`seat-lifecycle.md:37`) names no actor, no deadline and no write path, so a claim can sit for days with no PR while every serial dependent waits. Reproduced on #21892 (p1, `domain:skills#1`): claimed 2026-10-05, last branch commit the same day, no PR; triage's owned-24h re-check (comment 6020741621) asked the holder for one line and has had no answer for over 10 hours; #21915 (serial on the same files) is held behind it. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287, `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`) on the maintainer's instruction in this session, verbatim: 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 ⛔ Not a claim; ⛔ not a release of #21892 — that act belongs to triage or the maintainer (`SKILL.md:146`).
Reader: triage first-touch → `domain:skills` (the protocol text and the write tool are this lane's); when the hold lifts, the skills seat dispatches it to one os-dev.
Dedupe: REST listings, closed included (`labels=tooling` since 2026-09-07: 417; every issue updated since 2026-10-01: 625; `domain:skills` since 2026-09-23: 109; union 1,030) grepped for `liveness|owned-24|stale claim|silent seat|no PR is open|release.*(queue|claim)|recycl` → 18 hits, every one about the spec property-liveness ledger or ownership records, none about reclaiming a silent claim. Prior art #19777 (closed): a suspended seat account is a dead session — the takeover path; it covers a dead account, not a live account that stays silent.

Maintainer hold at filing, verbatim: 「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」 — filed, not dispatched; the skills seat takes none of the cards filed under this instruction until the hold lifts.
Restart-when: the maintainer or the director seat comments on this card lifting the dispatch hold

## What is measured

- #21892: claim 5998606892 (`os-tesla`, `domain:skills#1`, 2026-10-05); branch `claude/issue-21892-no-run-is-unconfirmed` at `4c5f2c15fc`, 7 commits ahead of `main`, last commit the day of the claim; no PR; seat post #7623 has no marker after R1. Triage's owned-24h re-check 6020741621 names the two acceptable answers (the PR is coming / release to `pm:queue` with the branch named) and sets no deadline. At this filing the question has been open for over 10 hours and the claim for over 34.
- Consequence: #21915 (p3) is HELD serial behind it (hold note 6018132699); a p1 security invariant (#19774's class) stays unfixed; the lane's second seat may not take either card (`SKILL.md:103`: an assignee that is not yours is never touched).
- Rules read: `seat-lifecycle.md:37` (活性只认在任者自己的产出, 超过一天即可回收 — 「即可」 names no one); `SKILL.md:103` (离手恒走释放 … 弃飞无接管); `SKILL.md:146` (代执行他人指令的回收认领,评论带出处三件); `triage-duties.md` has the owned-24h re-check but no release step — `grep -n -E "回收|释放|release|24" references/triage-duties.md` → 0 lines naming a deadline or a write.

## Done when

- `triage-duties.md` gains the second half of the owned-24h re-check: N hours after an unanswered re-check (N a named constant in the text; proposal 12), triage releases the card in ONE fleet-write write set — a comment with the three provenance items (whose rule, verbatim, where), `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue`, assignee cleared, and a `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA` line so the next claimant starts from the existing commits. The holder's seat post is not edited.
- The write path exists and is relay-only: `label-write.mjs` (or `close-cards.mjs`, the dev measures which door fits) performs the release; a self-test row pins "a release never falls back to a direct write" (#21892's class).
- `seat-lifecycle.md:37` names the actor (triage) and the clock instead of 「即可」; `SKILL.md`'s claim template gains the optional `Resume-from:` line and `os-dev.md` tells a dev to start from that sha when present.
- ⛔ No release without the re-check comment first (a silent seat gets its one knock); ⛔ no change to the dead-account takeover path (#19777); ⛔ no edit to another seat's post.
- Pin: on a fixture card whose unanswered re-check is older than N hours the tool releases it and reads back `pm:queue` with no assignee; on one younger than N hours it refuses and says how long remains.
